result.title: Embodied AI Fails the Mirror Test: How a Simple Mirror Breaks Robot Policies
result.summary: Can a simple mirror expose the limitations of today's robotic manipulation policies? Inspired by the mirror self-recognition test in animal cognition, we investigate whether robot policies can reliably manipulate physical objects in scenes containing their reflections. We introduce RoboDojo-Mirror, a benchmark built on RoboDojo that preserves task objectives, success criteria, and policy checkpoints while comparing a mirror-free baseline with single-mirror, dual-mirror, and mirrored-tabletop conditions. Across five policies spanning Vision-Language-Action models, World Action Models, and agentic policies, every mirror condition reduces aggregate success rates: averaged over the three conditions, the drop ranges from 10.8 to 56.7 percentage points across policies, and it reaches 62.5 points on the mirrored tabletop. Because a mirror is also a physical obstacle, we compare it against geometrically matched non-reflective panels; 50--88\% of mirror-specific failures occur without recorded robot--panel contact, so direct collisions alone do not explain the degradation. Trajectory and contact analyses instead reveal recurring behaviors consistent with phantom targeting of reflected objects and spatial mislocalization of real ones. Targeted diagnostics further characterize grasping near reflections, policy-dependent pushing progress, and physical-target interaction under main-camera occlusion. Real-robot experiments with $π_{0.5}$ and FastWAM also show lower overall success rates under the upright-mirror and mirrored-tabletop conditions. These findings reveal a shared vulnerability to reflective environments across diverse robot policies and motivate reflection-aware evaluation of embodied intelligence. Code is available at https://github.com/iPPLab/robodojo-mirror.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 RoboDojo-Mirror 基准，在无镜、单镜、双镜与镜面桌面条件下比较五类 VLA、世界动作模型和 agentic 策略的操控成功率，并用几何匹配的非反射面板作对照，结合轨迹与接触分析指出失败源于对反射物体的「幽灵瞄准」和真实物体的空间误定位；π0.5 与 FastWAM 真机实验也复现下降。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作给出 VLM/VLA 策略在镜面干扰下的失败诊断，可供核查视觉证据筛选与任务必要空间信息在内部表示中是否被反射线索污染；但其关注机器人操控评测，未涉及 latent 状态的生成或使用机制，与 LVR 的联系需阅读原文进一步确认。
